messages:
Elias: Quick check — AetherGrid marketplace tile and one-pager ready for final review? Need legal + design ok to go live tomorrow morning. Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd
Maya: Opening it now. Quick q: which logo lockup are we shipping — partner's new condensed mark or the legacy horizontal? The condensed has tighter clearspace.
Raya: Partner emailed the condensed yesterday but Legal flagged missing ® and a trademark footnote. We should default to the legacy horizontal until they confirm.
Elias: Ok default to legacy. @Maya can you export SVG + 2x PNGs with 8px safe margin for the marketplace thumbnail and include transparent and white-bg versions?
Maya: Yep — exporting now. Also adding alt text proposal: "AetherGrid and Redwood Inference joint solution brief cover art" — thoughts?
Jared: Slight tweak for accessibility: "AetherGrid and Redwood Inference joint solution brief cover art" is fine. Prefer including the word 'art' or 'cover' for context. :thumbsup:
DesignBot: Assets exported: /files/marketplace/takeoff/aethergrid_legacy.svg, aethergrid_legacy@2x.png, aethergrid_legacy_whitebg.png
Raya: Visual note — co-badge color on the thumbnail fails contrast at small sizes (current #2b6cff). I adjusted to #0b66ff in the 'badge-v2' layer; see frame "thumbnail-compact".
Maya: Updated badge color on figma and re-exported. Also added a 24px min-touch area for the logo per marketplace spec.
Elias: One-pager copy — partner quote currently: "we reduced our inference costs by 45%". Legal wants a validation source or to soften to "up to 45%". @Jared can you confirm required phrasing?
Jared: We need either a signed ROI note from partner or change to "up to 45%" plus a parenthetical like "based on partner-reported results; results may vary." That keeps us safe.
Maya: I'll ask partner for the signed note; if not received by EOD I'll change to "up to 45%" in the draft.
Raya: Marketplace metadata checklist: add product_tags ["redwood-dedicated","aethergrid-integration"], region availability (NA, EU), and SKU mapping: AG-RW-INTG-001. Also include alt text and 2-line summary.
Elias: Perfect. If we get legal ok + partner confirmation by 17:00, we queue for publish in morning deploy. If not, we fallback to tile-only launch (no case study) and update later.
Maya: On it — pinging partner now. I'll post updates here.
Jared: Also ensure partner signs the brand usage waiver before we publish any co-branded assets.
Raya: Adding a final note: please include a screenshot of the solution brief page in the PR so ops can sanity-check thumbnails.
Elias: Thanks team. Small follow-up: can someone drop the final filenames here when done? Easier for the release script.
Maya: Files committed:
- aethergrid_legacy.svg
- aethergrid_legacy@2x.png
- aethergrid_legacy_whitebg.png
- aethergrid_onepager_v1.pdf
Elias: Got them, thanks. :rocket:
